name: vi-companion
description: A personal player workspace for manually tracking GTA VI play sessions, objectives, collections, platform preferences and private notes.

interface.description: Keep your own player workspace organized across PS5 and Xbox. Track manual sessions, objectives, collections and private notes.
starter_prompts: Connect my VI Companion player workspace.
Start a manual PS5 play session and set a focus for tonight.
Show my active objectives and suggest what to work on next.
Create a personal collection and track its progress.
Save a private note to my player workspace.
